verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches third-party UI component libraries. One production user built apps with Ionic 2 [angular-comm-3], an AngularJS user cites 'lots of... directives' [angular-comm-11], and `ng add` exists to add external libraries [angular-docs-16]. Against this, users report middling third-party library quality [angular-comm-10], a then-immature component library [angular-comm-2], and React having the larger plugin mindshare [angular-comm-6]. Missing for 10: first-party or independent documentation of a broad catalog of third-party UI component libraries, evidence of current (non-Angular-2-era) ecosystem breadth and quality, concrete named libraries beyond Ionic.
